findings.body:
**Reused agent cycles can skip the coverage check that readiness applies under valid vendor debt.**

`findReusableCycle` selects the latest same-identity terminal full-scope cycle. It filters on `completion.kind === 'terminal'` and `vendorFailure === undefined` only. A cycle that lacks `agentCoverage` can therefore be selected. `dev.review` reuses that selection before any vendor dispatch. If the readiness check then requires coverage, it reports `agent-coverage`. A re-run of `dev.review` for the same identity can reuse the same cycle and does not produce a new one.

The coverage requirement applies only when vendor debt is valid. Readiness does not require coverage otherwise. The gap is therefore reachable only in the valid vendor-debt scenario. The proposed filter applies to all agent reuse. Narrow the trigger to vendor debt, or document why coverage should be required for every agent reuse.
findings.title: Reused agent cycles can skip the coverage check that readiness applies under valid vendor debt.
Stop the reuse check from blocking fresh dispatch when the retained log is missing or unreadable.
